entities.name: Liric
entities.description: A teacher at Hearth Fountain Academic who is secretly a Dimir agent, a remainder who walks Ravnica unseen with a strand, and who plans to leave the guild.

entities.name: Skrygix
entities.description: A tall goblin student in Liric's honors history class who paints him a caricature as a gift.

entities.name: Skrygix's brother
entities.description: Skrygix's little brother, who wears an Azorius Hussar costume to the Last Day celebration.

entities.name: Liric's father
entities.description: A shrunken Dimir interpreter who works a wall of sand built from memories; Liric wipes his memory of his son.

entities.name: Mareena
entities.description: The girl Liric first kissed at the corner of 12th and Veil in Ismeri.

entities.name: Lazav
entities.description: The Dimir guildmaster, whose likeness is stamped on the coin used to seal Liric's strand and who believes the Dimir must have a prize.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: The Izzet guildmaster, seen in an image in the wall of sand studying a model of Ravnica.

entities.name: Ral Zarek
entities.description: An Izzet mage glimpsed in the wall of sand's memories laughing while an elemental paws at ruins.

entities.name: Hearth Fountain Academic
entities.description: An exclusive, tuition-free school in Ravnica where Liric teaches.

entities.name: Ismeri
entities.description: A precinct of Ravnica where Liric grew up and where the Dimir operations house is.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The city-plane governed by guilds.

entities.name: Dimir
entities.description: The secretive guild of spies and mind magic that Liric serves and then abandons.

entities.name: Izzet
entities.description: The guild whose craftsmanship produced Liric's bag.

entities.name: Azorius
entities.description: A Ravnican guild; Skrygix's brother dresses as an Azorius Hussar.

entities.name: Orzhov
entities.description: A Ravnican guild; Skrygix styles her hair as an Orzhov aristocrat's headdress.

entities.name: Gruul
entities.description: A Ravnican guild; Skrygix paints Liric as a Gruul giant.

entities.name: Rakdos
entities.description: A Ravnican guild whose bouncers stand outside a dance hall.

entities.name: memory warden
entities.description: A Dimir guardian that speaks through the floor and challenges visitors with a puzzle question at the operations house.

entities.name: wall of sand
entities.description: A Dimir construct built from countless stolen memories that replays past events from all perspectives.

entities.name: strand
entities.description: A seemingly ordinary length of cord that serves as Liric's Dimir tool, used to open doors, shield him and erase minds.

entities.name: Implicit Maze
entities.description: A Ravnican trial the guilds are poised to run.

events.summary: On the Last Day before summer break, students celebrate around the Hearth Fountain while Liric, a teacher on his fifth year, watches anxiously.
events.quote: It was his fifth year as an instructor at HFA

events.summary: Skrygix gives Liric a painting of him as a Gruul giant in his classroom; he promises to hang it in his office.
events.quote: I'll have it framed, then hang it in my office here at school.

events.summary: Liric evades Skrygix's question about where he is going on his break.
events.quote: I'll be gone for a day or two, then back here for the rest of summer.

events.summary: Liric returns by zeppelid to Ismeri, the precinct where he grew up, and remembers his first kiss.
events.quote: He had grown up here in Ismeri

events.summary: Liric changes into his gatecloak, which fades his reflection.
events.quote: His cardigan with HFA emblem went into the Izzet bag, and his gatecloak came out.

events.summary: Liric enters a Dimir operations house, uses his strand to open the inner door and demands his welcome.
events.quote: "I'm here now. Where is my welcome?"

events.summary: The memory warden asks if Liric has brought a puzzle; he says he solved it, and the warden, not recognizing him, lets him down the stairs.
Liric reunites with his father, the Dimir interpreter, at the wall of sand.
Flashback: Liric was elevated to Dimir remainder in a ceremony where a guildmage sealed his strand with a coin bearing Lazav's likeness.
events.quote: A symbol of the voided circle.

events.summary: Seven days earlier Liric had blanked the guildmage who performed his remainder, the only other person who could remember him.
events.quote: Liric had left the man blanked, slumped against a column in the Dinrova.

events.summary: Liric's father shows images in the sand, including Niv-Mizzet, Ral Zarek and a hooded figure in blue, and says Lazav believes the Dimir must have a prize.
events.quote: The guilds are poised to run the Implicit Maze.

events.summary: Liric uses his strand to erase his father's memories of him, resolving that his father is the last he will steal from and that he will leave the Dimir.
events.quote: His father would be the last, absolutely the last, and tomorrow, he would no longer be Dimir.

events.summary: Liric's father does not recognize him and sits back down before the wall.
events.quote: "I'm sorry agent... I've forgotten your name. Did you come to make a deposit?"

events.summary: Liric unravels his strand in an alley, resolving to bury it in the school garden and live as a schoolteacher.
events.quote: He was just a schoolteacher now.

relations.note: Dimir remainder who quits the guild
relations.quote: tomorrow, he would no longer be Dimir.
